CommunityApplications.Profile: Factorio Server Control is a maintained modern fork of the original Factorio Server Manager by OpenFactorioServerManager and provides an Unraid template for a self-hosted Factorio dedicated-server manager. It includes profile-scoped saves, mods, game settings, Factorio versions, Space Age mode, checkpoints, world creation, resource-aware factory-map snapshots with named platform detail, users, logs and safe server controls. Source and support are available through the GitHub project. Development is generative-AI-assisted and maintainer-reviewed; the deployed manager contains no AI model and sends no runtime data to AI services. Maintained by Tricade, a lifelong tech nerd interested in AI, smart homes, homelabs and practical open-source tools for self-hosters.
